title: G1 SAC Locomotion Runtime Flow
subtitle: Training and interactive playback route for G1WalkFlat / G1WalkHeight with explicit Walking, Standing, height, gait, and checkpoint boundaries.

nodes.title: CLI selects feature flags
nodes.role: 训练入口只负责显式 feature flag 路由。
nodes.input: uv run train --algo sac --task g1_walk_flat --sim mujoco plus optional --height-tracking or --standing-reward.
nodes.output: task=sac/g1_walk_flat/mujoco by default; task=sac/g1_walk_height/mujoco for height; +g1_walk_stage=mixed_mode for Standing.
nodes.forbidden: 默认 Walking 不能隐式启用 Standing reward, mode_observation, height command, 或 gait_constraint bridge.
nodes.diagnostic: code-confirmed: src/unilab/cli.py:208-267, 270-284; tests in tests/test_cli.py and tests/config/test_reward_injection.py.

children.title: Default Walking owner config
children.role: 原版 Walking 训练 contract。
children.output: 98-dim actor observation, Walking scales, offset gait phase, curriculum, SAC symmetry.
children.forbidden: 不能包含 env.mode_observation, reward.mode, reward.gait_constraint, or height observe fields unless explicitly opted in elsewhere.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: config lines 1-57. runtime-unconfirmed: current checkpoint still falls; needs live reward/termination sentinel before changing weights.

children.title: SAC training builds env and actor dims
children.input: resolved cfg, BackendAdapter env override, task owner YAML.
children.output: G1WalkEnv instance, obs_groups_spec, action_dim, symmetry augmentation, FastSACLearner.
children.forbidden: learner 不能猜 observation 维度; 必须由 env.obs_groups_spec 决定。
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: scripts/train_offpolicy.py:142-260. runtime-unconfirmed: no live trace yet for the newly falling run.

children.title: Command sampler assigns mode distribution
children.role: 命令分布和 gait_enabled 初始状态。
children.forbidden: Standing/transition rows must not appear in default Walking unless the profile explicitly sets their probability.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: joystick.py:70-95, 358-467. live-risk: must log command histogram at reset for falling run.

children.title: Observation contract creates 98/99/100 dims
children.input: gyro, gravity, joint diff, dof_vel, last action, command, gait phase, optional mode, optional height.
children.output: actor obs and critic obs dict entries consumed by SAC.
children.forbidden: Checkpoint/playback cannot silently use a different optional observation set than training.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: joystick.py:520-526, 610-666, 668-919. tested: playback 98/99/100 fallback contract in tests/scripts/test_train_scripts.py.

children.title: Reward dispatch chooses vanilla or mode reward
children.output: vanilla run_reward_dispatch when reward.mode.enabled=false; masked walk/stand/recovery dispatch when enabled.
children.forbidden: Default Walking reward should not execute Standing masks or overrides.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: joystick.py:949-1010. live-risk: falling run needs per-term reward and termination probe.

children.title: Walking gait reward terms
children.input: gait_phase, feet positions, contacts, linvel, swing height.
children.output: feet_phase, contrast, contact, double stance, air-time reward components.
children.forbidden: Standing reward must not require foot lifting; Walking reward must not be suppressed by stand-only terms.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: joystick.py:1181-1268. live-risk: current direct fall may occur before gait reward matters.

children.title: Optional Standing branch
children.input: mode_observation, gait_enabled, stand recovery speed/tilt thresholds, stand terms and scale overrides.
children.output: standing reward, recovery reward, optional action authority, frozen stand phase.
children.forbidden: Default Walking path must not pay Standing losses or freeze phase.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: mixed_mode.yaml:1-126 and joystick.py:764-859, 1270-1386. runtime-unconfirmed: no successful stable Standing checkpoint yet.

children.title: Action execution advances gait phase
children.role: policy action to PD target boundary。
children.input: policy action, current gait_phase, optional stand_action_authority.
children.output: executed_actions, updated gait_phase, control target = action * action_scale + default_angles.
children.forbidden: Action execution must not decide reward weights or command distribution.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: joystick.py:1407-1483. live-risk: direct falling requires action/action_scale/default pose probe.

children.title: Optional Standing mixed profile
children.output: mode_observation=true, command mixture, standing reward mode, gait_constraint freeze settings.
children.forbidden: This profile must not become the default Walking config.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: mixed_mode.yaml:1-126. design-risk: current monolithic env makes accidental cross-contamination easy.

children.title: Optional height tracking profile
children.output: observe_height_command=true, random_height_during_walking=true, actor obs +1 height dimension, height reward scale.
children.forbidden: Height command cannot silently change G1WalkFlat actor dimension.

children.title: Interactive playback restores checkpoint contract
children.role: 本地 macOS 仿真回放兼容层。
children.input: start.sh -> play_interactive.py, selected checkpoint, sibling run_config.json.
children.output: env_cfg_override compatible with actor input dim before create_sac_playback_session.
children.forbidden: Playback compatibility fixes must not alter training defaults or checkpoint files.
children.diagnostic: code-confirmed: play_interactive.py:268-354, 1236-1305; interactive_playback.py:695-815. tested: 5 playback contract tests passed in latest run.

children.title: Open live failure boundary
children.role: 机器人直接倒地目前仍未定位。
children.input: newly trained SAC checkpoint that loads but falls immediately.
children.output: next probe must print reset pose, obs dim, command histogram, reward mode flags, first-step action stats, base height/tilt termination reason.
children.forbidden: Do not tune reward weights again without this live sentinel; do not claim playback fix implies policy quality fix.
children.diagnostic: runtime-unconfirmed. Needs a no-viewer short rollout probe near G1WalkEnv.update_state/apply_action and SAC actor output.
